redCandidate.publicEntry: BattleSimulation.TryFire, EndActiveTurn and Tick through the Unity EditMode battle harness
redCandidate.setup: A player deploys weapon.guardian-drone, then the opponent moves into its 1.6-unit detection range during its active turn.
redCandidate.expected: The combat action returns Fired; the deployed drone fires once at its original target, damages it, and ends that target's active turn.
redCandidate.observed: The combat action returns Blocked before any guardian deployment can occur.
